text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, what should I do...!? Where on 
earth did I drop my wallet~~...!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh... No, no, no... Air Groove-san is 
gonna scold me again... No no no nooo—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh? ...Wait—what?! You're the one who 
found my wallet?”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Heh heh, fufufu. Sorry for troubling 
you. You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected stroke of luck— I shall 
gladly accept it. In return, I vow to 
accept any invitation to play games at any 
time.
